subject: Web Development
title: AJAX and the Rebirth
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: AJAX and the Rebirth.

hook.text: By 2004, JavaScript seemed stuck. Then Google showed what it could really do.

buildup.text: Google Maps used XMLHttpRequest to load map tiles without refreshing the page.

discovery.text: Jesse James Garrett coined the term AJAX — Asynchronous JavaScript and XML.

twist.text: The technique existed since 1999. It took five years and one killer app to unlock its power.

climax.text: AJAX proved JavaScript could build real applications, not just add annoying popups.

punchline.text: One demo turned a toy language into a platform.

quiz.question: What does the 'A' in AJAX stand for?
